subject: Error: no milestone data found for part(s) 2 or 4.

messages.author: 37ed8c2830074fdd
messages.subject: Error: no milestone data found for part(s) 2 or 4.
parts:
Hi,
I am hoping someone can help me diagnose an issue I am having and find a solution.
While processing physical activity data, I get the following issues in two cwa files:
First cwa files:
Error as follows:
No milestone data found for part(s) 4. Run this/these first before running part 5.

Second cwa files:
Error as follows:
No milestone data found for part(s) 2. Run this/these first before running part 3.
In addition: Warning message:
In g.readaccfile(filename = datafile, blocksize = blocksize, blocknumber = i,  :
File empty, possibly corrupt.

The code I used in R studio as follows:
  # 运行 GGIR
  GGIR(mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),
       datadir = test_input,
       outputdir = outputdir,
       do.report=c(2,4,5),
       desiredtz = "Europe/London",
       windowsizes = c(5, 900, 3600),
       qwindow=c(0,24),
       minimumFileSizeMB = 2,
       #=====================
       # Part 2
       myfun = myfun,
       #=====================
       data_masking_strategy = 1, hrs.del.start = 0, hrs.del.end = 0,
       maxdur = 7,
       includedaycrit = 16,
       mvpathreshold =c(100), boutcriter = 0.8, mvpadur = c(1, 5, 10),
       #=====================
       # Part 3 + 4
       #=====================
       excludefirstlast = FALSE,
       includenightcrit = 16,
       def.noc.sleep = 1,
       do.visual = FALSE,
       #=====================
       # Part 5
       #=====================
       timewindow = c("MM","WW"),
       threshold.lig = c(30), threshold.mod = c(100,125),  threshold.vig = c(400),
       boutcriter.in = 0.9, boutcriter.lig = 0.8, boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8,
       boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig = c(1,5,10), boutdur.mvpa = c(1,5,10),                      
       includedaycrit.part5 = 2/3,
       #=====================
       # Visual report
       #=====================
       visualreport=FALSE)

Thanks in advance, sonla li.

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Error: no milestone data found for part(s) 2 or 4.
parts:
Dear Sonla,

Your error messages indicate that GGIR did not generate part 2 output, by which it will also not be able to do anything meaningful in part 3 and 4.

Did you try processing the file with only GGIR part 1 and 2 as in GGIR(mode = 1:2, do.report = 2, visualreport = FALSE) ?

If that generates output does the output give you any clues as to why GGIR struggles to process it. For example, was the accelerometer not work, was the recording too short, were acceleration values extreme?

Thanks,

Vincent

parts: Error: no milestone data found for part(s) 2 ,4 or 5.

Hi,
I am hoping someone can help me diagnose an issue I am having and find a solution.

When processing physical activity data, I encountered the following two issues:

First， the milestone data for Part 2 could not be found, making it impossible to run Part 2, which results in the loss of all outcomes.
The code I used in R studio as follows：

# 运行 GGIR Part 2
GGIR(mode=2, datadir = test_input, outputdir = outputdir, myfun = myfun)

Error：
2Error in process_sample(datadir, test_input_base, outputdir) :
Milestone data for part 2 not found. Please check the data and parameters.
In addition: Warning message:
No summary data available to be stored in csv-reports


Second， Part 2 was executed, but either Part 4 or Part 5 is missing.

The code I used in R studio as follows：
# 运行 GGIR
GGIR(mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),
datadir = test_input,
outputdir = outputdir,
do.report=c(2,4,5),
desiredtz = "Europe/London",
windowsizes = c(5, 900, 3600),
qwindow=c(0,24),

For cases where Part 5 is missing from the output：

Report part 5
loading all the milestone data from part 5 this can take a few minutes
generating csv report for every parameter configurations...

For cases where Part 4 is missing from the output:

Report part 4
loading all the milestone data from part 4 this can take a few minutes
report not stored,because no results available

Thanks in advance, sonla li
